 The St. Louis Blues (10-9-2) and Pittsburgh Penguins (7-11-2) will meet in the NHL tonight. Puck drop is set for 7:00 p.m. EST at PPG Paints Arena in Pittsburgh, Pa. The game will broadcast live on ESPN+.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Blues are favored at -110 on the moneyline, with the Blues -110 to pull off the upset. The over/under is set at 6.5 (-105o / -115u).
 Let's get into our Blues vs. Penguins predictions and NHL picks .
 Blues vs. Penguins Prediction
 Pick: Over 6.5 
 Our St. Louis vs. Pittsburgh best bet is on the over, with the best odds currently available at FanDuel. For all of your NHL bets, be sure to find the best lines by using our live NHL odds page. 
 Make sure to download the Action Network app for more NHL picks and analysis! 
 Blues vs Penguins Odds
 Blues vs. Penguins Puck Line: Penguins -1.5 (+225 ), Blues +1.5 (-310)
 Blues vs. Penguins Over/Under: 6.5 (+104o / -128u)
 Blues vs. Penguins Moneyline: Blues -110, Penguins -110
 Blues vs. Penguins Best Bet: Over 6.5
 It was announced that Joel Hofer will start for the Blues, who have been one of the best goaltenders in hockey.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The last time I rocked with Hofer, I was burned pretty bad when he dropped a 4-1 stinker to the Panthers. Regardless, I'm still a believer!
 His .921 SV% and 8.2 GSAx this season have been a valuable and consistent part of this roster, along with Jimmy Snuggerud's 10 goals.
 Meanwhile, the Penguins are one of the NHL's most curious cases. Could it be that age is starting to get to Sidney Crosby? His stat line has been remarkably quiet all season, with the exception of a two-goal game he posted in L.A.
 However, Pittsburgh is starting to get healthier, which is always nice. It's still missing Elmer Soderblom and Bryan Rust, and Nick Robertson is a game-time decision.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement But the one problem that has been bothering Pittsburgh has been goaltending. And that seems to be a major pain point for a lot of teams this season. Arturs Silovs is getting the nod, but his outlook has been less than ideal.
 In his last five games, Silovs has let up 19 goals, and before that let up 21 goals in his first six starts.
 So, I'm not particularly bullish on Pittsburgh's outlook this season, especially if he's the guy it plans on running with.
 I like the Blues' offense though. It ranks 11th in expected goals, and they have the talent to light up an already-vulnerable Silovs. Take the Over at plus-value.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Best Bet: Over 6.5 (+104)
